title: Exceptional Regenerative Composition Structures
statement: For sampling distributions induced by coalescents with simultaneous multiple collisions, characterized by measures $\Lambda_j$ on the simplices $\Delta_j$, are all corresponding composition structures nonregenerative except when $\Lambda_j=0$ for every $j\geq2$ and $\Lambda_1$ is concentrated at $0$ or at $1$?
